Name: Protective Gale
Description:
A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you for the spell's duration.

The wind has the following effects:
● It deafens you and other creatures in its area.
● It extinguishes unprotected flames in its area that are torch-sized or smaller.
● It hedges out vapor, gas, and fog that can be dispersed by strong wind.
● The area is difficult terrain for creatures other than you.
● Attack rolls of ranged weapon attacks have disadvantage if the attacks pass into or out of the wind.
● If you take falling damage, you take only half the damage you normally would.
● If you shove a creature or knock it prone while it is within the wind's radius, it is pushed to a space outside the radius.
At Higher Levels:
If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, it gains one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The wind's radius increases by 5 feet.
● Your movement speed increases by 5 feet as the wind pushes you while you move.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
